description: I am a high school student passionate about astrophysics and space exploration, participating solo from Chiclayo, Peru. My goal in the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge is to translate complex space engineering and survival dilemmas into an interactive, scientifically accurate experience for young minds. By integrating real NASA data, I aim to prove that any curious student can understand the real science behind deep space exploration.
summary: An interactive 2D lunar survival game for students aged 7–12 set on the Lunar Far Side. Players experience real 1/6th lunar gravity, collect crater ice, and make engineering trade-offs during a real NASA DONKI solar storm.
